scope.reviewed: V0.32 exact clear-boundary sources, targeted tests, assembled preload CJS graph and the clear-boundary documentation
scope.notReviewed: Host implementation, installed ZTools integration, operating-system clipboard behavior and target-application paste behavior

sourceV032.scope: Synthetic SDK and Linux VM only; no installed host or real clipboard

closedFindings.finding: A timestamp/id cursor range used as a clear cutoff can suppress an unseen new row at the same timestamp with a smaller ID, or after timestamp rollback.
closedFindings.fix: Clear suppression now uses membership in the confirmed SHA-256 identity set for exact (id,timestamp) pairs; `through` is retained only as a monotonic reference.
closedFindings.evidence: Same-timestamp lower-ID and lower-timestamp unseen-copy tests; replay harness asserts both new copies are retained while cleared rows remain excluded.

closedFindings.finding: A host page could report more returned items than its declared total and be accepted as a complete clear snapshot.
closedFindings.fix: Reader rejects `items.length > total` before boundary construction.

closedFindings.finding: The packaged replay harness did not protect its evidence-root path from symlink escape.
closedFindings.fix: Evidence root is lstat/realpath checked and required inside the real plugin root; descendant directories reject symlinks.

closedFindings.finding: The VM loader could follow a package-local CJS symlink outside the supplied package, and successful recovery reads were not counted by the old-image replay assertion.
closedFindings.fix: Each loaded chunk is realpath-contained in the package and rejected if it is a symlink; fixture counts both failed and successful source-image reads.
closedFindings.evidence: scripts/lib/preload-database-fixture.mjs:271-280 and 216-231; replay check `old-image-was-not-read-again` requires exactly the initial read.

v1Limitations: The host source provides no monotonic sequence. The existing main cursor still sorts by (timestamp,id); a genuinely new row at or behind an already saved main cursor can still be skipped. This patch does not establish end-to-end no-loss behavior.
The clear marker identifies rows only by (id,timestamp); host reuse of the exact pair is indistinguishable from the cleared row.

Offset pagination has no stable snapshot guarantee. Inserts, deletes, reorderings, or total changes between pages can omit rows; omitted identities may later reappear. The host may also fold a read error into a valid empty page that the plugin cannot distinguish from an empty history.

Per-device identity union is permanently bounded at 100,000 entries. Once union capacity is exceeded, a later nonempty clear fails closed before record deletion. The host's real database IPC size and latency for the roughly 6.7 MB marker were not tested.

Repeated old-row pagination and full boundary validation/cloning costs are not measured against the installed host. No real ZTools host, OS clipboard, Windows 10/11/12, or target-application paste acceptance was run; the package replay VM reports Linux and uses a synthetic SDK.

documentationReview.result: Consistent with reviewed source and evidence; it explicitly preserves the V1 limits and non-host acceptance boundary.
